steps.say: The paper gives such examples in its appendix. It inspects attention distributions from its models and shows encoder self-attention heads linking related words in a sentence.

As an illustrative tiny case, take the sentence dog lost its bone and fix the query word its with its four compatibility scores. The starting scores favor dog. Applying softmax turns scores into weights that sum to one, so its attends mostly to dog, like sharp anaphora in Figure 4.
